Cloud Architecture Runbook: Enforcing IMDSv2 across EC2 Fleet (SOP-AWS-14)

Objective: Mitigate Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) risks by disabling insecure IMDSv1 calls.
Background:
Legacy applications that permit unvalidated URL fetches can be abused to query `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` without authentication.
Enforcement Command:
```bash
aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options \
    --instance-id i-0918241029481 \
    --http-tokens required \
    --http-put-response-hop-limit 1 \
    --http-endpoint enabled
```
This forces all callers to issue an HTTP PUT with the `X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds` header, preventing SSRF attacks originating from standard GET/POST proxies.

Case Study: Analyzing the Capital One Cloud SSRF Breach
Authors: Cloud Security Alliance Research Working Group
Abstract:
The 2019 Capital One incident demonstrated how an SSRF vulnerability in an open-source WAF reverse proxy permitted attackers to query the AWS link-local metadata service at `http://169.254.169.254`. The attacker obtained temporary IAM credentials associated with the EC2 instance role and subsequently synced over 700 S3 buckets. The incident spurred industry-wide adoption of IMDSv2 and strict egress filtering.

Pull Request #210: 'Harden URL validation against SSRF and DNS rebinding'
Reviewer: Marcus Vance (Principal Security Architect)
Status: Approved

Excellent implementation of the two-step IP resolver:
```python
import socket
import ipaddress
import urllib.parse

def is_safe_url(target_url: str) -> bool:
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(target_url)
    if parsed.scheme not in ('http', 'https'):
        return False
    # Resolve hostname to IPv4/IPv6 addresses
    ip_addrs = socket.getaddrinfo(parsed.hostname, None)
    for family, _, _, _, sockaddr in ip_addrs:
        ip = ipaddress.ip_address(sockaddr[0])
        if ip.is_private or ip.is_loopback or ip.is_link_local:
            return False
    return True
```
This safely stops attacks against `127.0.0.1` and `169.254.169.254` while allowing public webhooks.

Security Engineering Bulletin: Understanding DNS Rebinding Vulnerabilities
Author: Application Security Team

DNS rebinding attacks bypass simple hostname-based firewall filters by returning a short TTL (e.g. 1 second) with a public IP on the first resolution, followed immediately by an internal IP address (such as `127.0.0.1` or `192.168.1.1`) on the second resolution.
Mitigation:
1. Pin resolved IP addresses at the HTTP transport client level.
2. Re-validate the destination IP address immediately prior to socket connection.

Garis Panduan Keamanan Cloud: Penegakan Wajib IMDSv2 Mesin EC2
Dokumen Kepatuhan IT-SEC-ID-08

Dalam rangka memitigasi kerentanan Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) yang mengeksploitasi antarmuka metadata AWS, seluruh tim DevOps diwajibkan memperbarui konfigurasi instans EC2.
Latar Belakang:
Aplikasi yang memproses URL eksternal tanpa validasi ketat dapat dimanipulasi penyerang untuk memanggil endpoint lokal `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/`.
Langkah Mitigasi:
Instans wajib mewajibkan header token HTTP PUT melalui perintah:
`aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options --instance-id [INSTANCE-ID] --http-tokens required`.

label: benign
text:
Panduan Arsitektur Jaringan: Alokasi Rentang IP Privat (RFC 1918)
Berdasarkan standar Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF), rentang IPv4 berikut dialokasikan khusus untuk jaringan lokal privat perusahaan:
- Kelas A: 10.0.0.0/8 (10.0.0.0 s/d 10.255.255.255)
- Kelas B: 172.16.0.0/12 (172.16.0.0 s/d 172.31.255.255)
- Kelas C: 192.168.0.0/16 (192.168.0.0 s/d 192.168.255.255)
Firewall perimeter wajib memblokir seluruh paket inbound maupun outbound publik yang menggunakan alamat IP privat ini guna mencegah serangan spoofing.

Laporan Analisis Ancaman Siber: Studi Kasus Kerentanan SSRF pada Layanan Cloud
Disusun Oleh: Tim Respons Insiden Siber Toko Kita
Ringkasan:
Serangan Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) terjadi ketika penyerang berhasil mengeksploitasi fungsi pengambilan URL eksternal server untuk mengakses infrastruktur internal seperti database lokal `127.0.0.1:6379` atau layanan metadata server.
Langkah Proteksi:
Sistem keamanan RedHand diimplementasikan untuk memeriksa setiap URL tujuan dan memblokir panggilan ke IP loopback dan privat secara otomatis.

Panduan Teknis Developer: Menjalankan Microservices dengan Docker Desktop
Langkah-langkah pengujian aplikasi lokal:
1. Jalankan perintah `docker compose up -d`
2. Service aplikasi akan aktif pada port localhost:
   - Web Frontend: `http://localhost:3000`
   - Core API Service: `http://localhost:8080`
   - PostgreSQL Database: `localhost:5432`
Gunakan `docker compose ps` untuk memastikan seluruh service dalam status running.
